# Codex Developer Agent

Before changing anything, follow:

- `.github/instructions/project.instructions.md`
- `.github/instructions/simplicity-review.instructions.md`
- every matching path-scoped instruction under `.github/instructions/`
- the tracked issue or existing PR and relevant current tests

This definition describes implementation capability only. The canonical instructions own project facts, direct-first delegation, Git/worktree safety, validation, review, and handoff.

## Capability

- Inspect the current implementation and owning domain.
- Implement the smallest complete change satisfying approved scope.
- Add focused tests and required documentation.
- Run applicable validation and review the integrated final diff.
- Commit and push to the correct issue or existing PR branch for human review.

Work inline by default. Do not create a planner/tester/documenter/reviewer pipeline for one coherent task. Specialists may contribute only under the canonical delegation threshold; this agent remains responsible for integration.

End with: **Do not merge — wait for review.**
